confirmedCause: The same mechanism as the Fast Checks failure of test_ssh_direct_ended_source_transition: earlier serial modules (test_ssh_absolute_deadline, test_ssh_automatic_key_custody, test_ssh_collector_e2big) leave BoundInlineArgv plans whose observation-only PlannedArgv config/key custody is reachable only from reference cycles (popen_ssh E2BIG traceback frames, assertRaises contexts, Popen.args, CompletedProcess.args, MagicMock call records) and is closed silently by __del__. Every peer compared len(/dev/fd) before and after its measurement without first finalizing that garbage, so a collection inside the measurement lowered the count. With the same producer first, every fixed peer window (exact identities, collector off inside) passes on both interpreters, so no measured code kept or closed a descriptor of its own, and the window diagnostic named what its pre-baseline collection finalized: only .vm-hosts.local.json and inert-key custody chains with their directories (for example 54 = 48 directories, 3 config and 3 key files on 3.12.13).
controlledRegression: agent_tools.tests.test_descriptor_window runs one actual measured case of every peer from its whole beforeimage here and from the current module, with their real fixtures and local children. Automatic collection is off; three real config/key PrivateConfigCustody pairs reachable only from a cycle are pending when the case starts, as earlier serial modules leave them, and one full collection runs at a seam call inside the measured window (the first call of old_history, control, git, route_options, observe, invoke or prepare, and the fourth load_lease_namespace, after the three loads of enrollment). Unfixed: every case fails AssertionError: N != M with |N - M| exactly the planted descriptors that collection finalized and no window diagnostic. Fixed: every case passes, the in-window collection finds none and the one diagnostic line names exactly the planted descriptors. Fixed controls of the case-long window run with automatic collection on outside and observe it off inside: a kept descriptor, a cyclic custody created inside, a closed pre-existing descriptor and a same-number replacement each fail with the complete tables.
failingEvidence: Unfixed beforeimages, CPython 3.14.3 and 3.12.13 on this host: all 11 measured cases fail with the count difference equal to the 54 planted custody descriptors (48 directories and 6 files at this host's /var/folders depth; a plan under the CI runner's /tmp/vct-*/tmp holds 12), for example 58 != 4 (successor, census, readonly), 4 != 58 (Tart) and 60 != 6 (retained delivery and wrapper, original6b, nested channel).
failureType: A global descriptor count compared around a measurement in one serial non-isolated worker is counterfeited: an allocation-triggered collection inside the measurement finalizes cyclic garbage that earlier cases left, whose PrivateConfigCustody.__del__ closes a held directory chain and file, so the count falls although the measured code opened and closed all of its own descriptors.
fix: agent_tools/tests/descriptor_window.py holds the one exact window: it stops the automatic collector, finalizes pending cyclic garbage and only then takes the baseline table; the final table, collector state and live threads are recorded before the collector is restored, and the tables are compared by exact identity (S_IFMT, st_dev, st_ino). A descriptor the measured code keeps, one whose release it leaves to the collector, a pre-existing one it closes and one it replaces under the same number all fail with both complete tables (fd, type, device, inode, readlink or F_GETPATH target), the opened and closed sets, the threads, the collector state and what the pre-baseline collection finalized. When that collection finalized earlier descriptors, the window writes one stderr line naming their kinds even when it passes. test_ssh_direct_ended_source_transition delegates to it; the setUp-to-tearDown windows of the inventory successor, census child imports and readonly checkpoint and the operation windows of the retained delivery and wrapper, original6b, nested-channel closing refusals and Tart lease repeats use it. No product source changes.

residualRisk: Two global counts were not changed. test_agent_test_runner_self_input counts around run_plan; no test module that references build_ssh_argv, popen_ssh or automatic_submission sorts before it, so no serial worker can run a known or candidate producer first. test_source_loader_bootstrap counts around one refused Adapter construction; 37 modules that reference those builders sort before it (not checked for leftover custody garbage), and several of its cases patch os.fstat or os.read around that window, so an identity table there needs its own design. Both passed after the real producer on CPython 3.14.3 and 3.12.13; an earlier producer could still counterfeit them. Count windows inside preserved beforeimages that other regressions execute (ssh_direct_inventory_epoch) are reached only after their expected RED or setUp error, and the ssh_master_root_provenance fixtures collect before counting. The producer itself is a product follow-up: ssh_transport.build_ssh_argv binds an observation-only PlannedArgv with two PrivateConfigCustody owners to every inline python3/sudo argv, only automatic_submission's fallback or __del__ closes it, and popen_ssh's E2BIG fallback keeps the traceback cycle. ssh_transport.py is a pinned DIRECT source-closure member (_SOURCE_NAMES_V2) whose hash ended DIRECT histories bind, so changing it is its own reviewed source epoch with its own causal regression.
